text.en:
The sum of One Million Five Hundred Thousand (P1.5-M) Pesos from the Special Fund of the
Forest Products Research and Industries Development Commission is hereby appropriated to finance the
low-cost housing quarters for its deserving employees as the Commission may determine."

This Decree shall take effect immediately."
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
